limits.body_budget_note: Application-consumed decoded media response-body bytes are observed after body chunks are read. A crossing chunk and in-flight chunks may overshoot; this is not a wire-byte cap.

metadata.preflight_note: Standalone Python metadata preflight received HTTP 412 for both fixtures. That result did not predict the library harness path; these measurements are from the successful project harness runs.

records.size_probe_observation_scope: one shared case setup; repeated metadata only; excluded from each group transfer total
records.request_id_scope: IDs are local to each progress-reporter call; shared standalone_probe IDs are recorded separately and are not globally unique
records.request_count_semantics: unique media-transfer request IDs seen in body or terminal/retry diagnostics; lower bound because no request-start event is emitted; API/auth requests are excluded
records.transfer_activity_semantics: first/last times are relative to the group or standalone probe collector; includes body or phase-tagged diagnostic events only, omits connection and response-header wait, and is neither full request latency nor additive concurrency time
records.body_measurement: response body chunks after transparent gzip decoding; excludes API/auth responses; not wire bytes
records.body_budget_semantics: cancel after the first observed crossing chunk/request; the crossing chunk and in-flight decoded chunks may overshoot; not a wire cap
